content: {"phoneNote":"The 130px two-row header plus 'Navodila za pot' repeated four times down the page (header, hero, hours band, contact) and hours/address shown twice make the phone page feel padded and repetitive despite the strong plate motif.","desktopNote":"Large empty right halves in the hero, process and price sections, plus a footer wordmark bigger than the hero headline, break the rhythm; the vineyard mood photo says nothing about tyres.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Collapse contact repetition: keep one hours/address block (contact section) and drop the extra 'Navodila za pot' links in header row 2, hero and hours band.","Replace the vineyard landscape with a workshop/tyre photo (or go fully typographic with the plate motif) and on desktop use the empty right half of hero/process/prices for it.","Shrink the footer wordmark and tighten the phone header to a single row so the headline starts higher on the first screen."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop full page: the same address, hours and 'Navodila za pot' contact block is repeated in the hours band, contact section and footer.","Phone and desktop full-page capture: the sticky header sits over the hero headline, hiding 'HITRO IN' — check the fixed header does not cover content on scroll."]}
